detector: Project-pinned YuNet with its existing published score/NMS settings
zero_faces: Review locator failure, intended ROI and input content; no automatic acceptance, quarantine or exclusion
multiple_faces: Review intended target and label/ROI correspondence; no automatic acceptance, quarantine or exclusion
exactly_one_face: Review supplied-box alignment and native-crop quality; detection is not sufficient for acceptance
label_usage: Retain the original label as evidence; neither live nor spoof labels certify ROI validity
quarantine_basis: Confirmed wrong ROI/target or confirmed unusable input, supported by source-bound review evidence
inference_gate: Runtime uncertain for zero/multiple detected faces remains separate from training-data eligibility
historical_audit_dispositions: All old face-count-derived proposed_disposition values remain diagnostic observations only. Eligibility comes from explicit content-review decisions under this policy; preserve historical audit receipts and source snapshots.
eligibility_basis: Source image, supplied crop, intended target/label correspondence and native input quality
detector_role: Candidate discovery and review prioritization only; no detector confirmation is required for a source-content finding
confirmed_wrong_roi_or_target: Quarantine directly based on recorded content-review evidence; do not require detector agreement or a replacement bbox
confirmed_unusable_crop: Quarantine based on recorded input-quality findings; native size alone is not an unreviewed automatic cutoff
correct_roi: Assess input quality; retain only when correct and usable are confirmed
unresolved_roi_or_quality: Keep in review; do not equate uncertainty with a confirmed defect
filtered_dataset_reporting: Retain original split identity and source bytes; record exclusions by split/type. Report the result as a filtered project subset, not the intact original benchmark
